decision: Recipe A confirmed as the Phase 2 single-model candidate

recipe.backbone: CellposeDINO ViT-B (kernel16/stride8), whole native 972x1296 frame, replicate-pad to 992x1312
recipe.ssl: fold-train-only LeJEPA SSL 5 epochs, seed 1003, runner phase2_crossfold_ssl_20261015
recipe.pooling: std (population std of final normed patch tokens)
recipe.head: LayerNorm -> Linear128 -> GELU -> Linear3
recipe.regression: 20 epochs, schedule10 (1 warmup epoch, cosine to 0.1 by epoch10, then flat), head lr 1e-3, encoder lr 1e-5, AdamW wd 1e-4, global clip 1.0, effective batch 16 (2 GPUs x 4 x 2), bf16
recipe.loss: 0.5 standardized log L1 + 0.5 physical MAPE / 0.2 (frozen runner)
recipe.checkpoint: fixed terminal epoch 20; no best-epoch switching
recipe.inference: one whole-frame view; no TTA, calibration or ensemble

evidence.gate: submission_plan_20261020 promotion_gates: >=0.03pp across >=2 folds and >=2 seeds — met by all four pairs
evidence.reviewed_flag: fold4_seed47 HEX +0.059pp; HEX improves in the other three pairs (-0.036, -0.106, -0.153)

not_included.green_point_auxiliary: worsened regression at weights 0.01 (+0.027) and 0.1 (+0.047), mainly CD
not_included.nested_calibration: scalar -0.014pp on one outer fold, below the 0.03 threshold
not_included.ssl10: fold4 gain did not replicate on fold0

next: 5-fold OOF of recipe A (experiments/oof_recipeA_20261027), then candidate package A
limitations: Development folds are historically reused; not an official or independent score
Patient independence and near-duplicate leakage unresolved
H200 training is not T4 deployment certification
